summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Nicola Mining Inc. reporting an operations update on exploration activities at its New Craigmont Copper Project. The filing discusses the completion of an inaugural drill hole at the Jotun target, soil geochemistry, and an airborne geophysical survey. It provides geological analysis and forward-looking exploration plans. There are no terms of a transaction, board recommendation, or special-situation event. The filing is a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation filing.
